newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig still a buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it was maintaining its buy rating on Minas Gerais state power distributor Cemig.
-- It said its recommendation was based in the efforts Cemig is making to increase productivity by cutting workforce and costs.
-- Fator also highlighted the forthcoming block sale of a 33 percent voting stake in Cemig to a strategic operator which "should speed up necessary changes and boost productivity."
-- Cemig preferred shares traded at 45.80 reais, up 1.55 percent, earlier on the Sao Paulo bourse.
